components.name: Information Panel
components.description: White bordered container for payment events, metrics, and ledger records.
components.html:
Payment events

Recent checkout outcomes across connected merchants.
components.css: .ds-panel { background: #ffffff; color: #111416; border: 1px solid #e2e6e9; border-radius: 13px; padding: 20px; font: 400 14px/1.45 'DM Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-panel h2 { margin: 0; color: #111416; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 650; letter-spacing: -0.02em; } .ds-panel p { margin: 5px 0 0; color: #66717d; font-size: 12px; } .ds-panel:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #111416; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Feature Panel
components.description: Near-black surface for a focused payment pattern or operational summary.
components.html:
Transaction pattern

Three recorded failures share a processor response code.
components.css: .ds-feature { background: #111416; color: #ffffff; border-radius: 13px; padding: 20px; font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-feature h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 650; } .ds-feature p { max-width: 34ch; margin: 8px 0 0; color: #e2e6e9; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.5; }

components.name: Primary Action Button
components.description: Compact dark action used for the main task in a panel.
components.css: .ds-button { min-height: 36px; border: 1px solid #111416; border-radius: 8px; background: #111416; color: #ffffff; padding: 0 14px; font: 600 11px 'DM Sans', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-button:hover:not(:disabled) { border-color: #30383d; background: #30383d; } .ds-button:active:not(:disabled) { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #111416; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-button:disabled { opacity: .5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: Pill-shaped search input in the admin top bar.
components.css: .ds-search { display: flex; height: 36px; align-items: center; gap: 10px; border: 1px solid #e2e6e9; border-radius: 999px; background: #ffffff; padding: 0 12px; color: #66717d; } .ds-search input { width: 100%; min-width: 0; border: 0; outline: 0; background: transparent; color: #111416; font: 400 12px 'DM Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-search input::placeholder { color: #66717d; opacity: 1; } .ds-search:focus-within { outline: 2px solid #111416; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Section Rail Item
components.description: Icon-led anchor in the narrow dashboard rail with an accessible name.
components.css: .ds-rail-item { display: grid; width: 42px; height: 42px; place-items: center; border-radius: 12px; color: #66717d; transition: background 160ms ease, color 160ms ease, transform 160ms ease; } .ds-rail-item svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.7; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-rail-item:hover { background: #f6f7f8; color: #111416; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-rail-item[aria-current='location'] { background: #111416; color: #ffffff; } .ds-rail-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #111416; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Semantic Status Chip
components.description: Compact success or failure label for a recorded payment outcome.
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; min-height: 24px; align-items: center; border-radius: 8px; background: #e9f7ef; padding: 0 8px; color: #13834e; font: 600 9px/1.3 'DM Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-status.failed { background: #fff0ee; color: #dc3938; } .ds-status:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #111416; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Live Scan Stream
components.description: Dark event surface that lists transaction checks with levels and references.
components.html:
[INFO] Order context matched · origin human.

[WARN] AVS response was not recorded.
components.css: .ds-stream { display: grid; gap: 9px; border: 1px solid #252629; border-radius: 13px; background: #111214; padding: 17px; color: #d4d9dc; font: 400 10px/1.55 'Cascadia Code', Consolas, monospace; } .ds-stream p { margin: 0; } .ds-stream b { color: #88b7ef; font-weight: 700; } .ds-stream .warn b { color: #f0ac67; } .ds-stream:focus-within { outline: 2px solid #111416; outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview:
The merchant console is an operations surface for reviewing checkout outcomes, payment incidents, and case evidence. It keeps PayProof's Sandbox and demo constraints visible. Payment records help operators investigate an incident; they do not establish customer intent.

The main workspace pairs a quiet white canvas with crisp black feature panels. A narrow icon rail preserves section-based navigation, while a separate activity stream keeps recent payment and case events in view on wide screens. Secondary records sit lower on the page so the opening view remains focused.

These rules describe `/admin`. The storefront at `/` retains its existing visual treatment until it is redesigned separately.
dos: Do label all demo data as simulated.
Do keep failures, pending states, and successful outcomes visually distinct.
Do retain functional section anchors and keyboard focus states.
donts: Don't infer customer intent from payment state.
Don't fill the first viewport with every available record.
